project_type: Multi-language runtime-tracing / code-explanation framework. Rust core engine with language binding crates (Python PyO3, Node Neon, Java JNI/JVMTI, C FFI, Go CGO) plus a CLI crate.
language: Rust (primary). TypeScript for the planned VS Code extension and web dashboard frontend.
build_system: Cargo workspace. Root Cargo.toml is [workspace] only (no [package]). Members currently: xplainit-core, xplainit-python, xplainit-node, xplainit-c, xplainit-java. NOTE: xplainit-cli and xplainit-go are present on disk but commented out of workspace members. Python module builds from inside xplainit-python via `maturin develop --release` (module name `xplainit`, venv at .venv).
test_framework: Rust built-in `cargo test` (unit + doc tests, all crates green at baseline). Python scripts run directly with the venv python (e.g. `python test_automatic_tracing.py`).
test_command: cargo test  (workspace). Plus clippy gate: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings. Python: source .venv/bin/activate; cd xplainit-python; maturin develop --release; then run test_frame_filter.py / test_depth_accounting.py / test_decorators.py / test_automatic_tracing.py.
verification_instructions: 1) cargo build --release  2) cargo test  3) cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings (must be zero warnings)  4) cargo fmt --all -- --check  5) For CLI: build the xplainit binary and run each subcommand against a sample trace/log JSON to confirm real output. 6) Python suites must still pass after any core change that affects bindings. Trust actual command output over the many *_COMPLETE.md status docs, which have been inaccurate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No snapshot/golden-file directories. Cargo.lock is checked in and must stay consistent; adding deps updates it. Do not add new external crates unless already present in Cargo.lock (network is repository-access-only).
setup_instructions: Rust toolchain is preinstalled. For Python work: `source .venv/bin/activate` at repo root, then `cd xplainit-python && maturin develop --release`. gcc 11.5 / clang 15 / JDK 25 / go 1.25 present for the other bindings.
environment_constraints: Network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (repository access only): no npm registry, no VS Code marketplace/vsce, no fetching NEW crates.io deps or pulling Docker images. node/npm are ABSENT; only bun 1.2.14 is present and bun cannot load Neon N-API addons. CONSEQUENCE: the VS Code extension (Task 3.2) and any JS-toolchain web-dashboard frontend (Task 3.5) CANNOT be `npm install`ed / packaged / run in this sandbox. Their TypeScript source can be authored and type-reasoned by hand, but build/test must be documented as blocked, not claimed as passing. Deps already in Cargo.lock and usable: clap 4.6, tokio 1.53, uuid 1.26, serde_json 1.0, chrono 0.4, regex 1.10, colored, anyhow. `rand` is NOT in Cargo.lock, so FrequencyFilter sampling must be deterministic/counter-based (no rand crate).
contribution_requirements: Keep the whole workspace green after every task: cargo test, cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, and the Python suites. New Rust features must ship with real tests that fail if the feature is reverted. No PRs: work lands on a branch (e.g. phase3-feature-complete) for the orchestrator to fast-forward-merge into master. Do not overstate completion; document sandbox-blocked build steps honestly. Never use em dashes in written content.
key_patterns: Filters: filter.rs defines `trait EventFilter { fn should_capture(&self, event: &ExecutionEvent, config: &Config) -> bool; fn description(&self) -> String; }` with impls AcceptAllFilter/FunctionFilter/EventTypeFilter/DepthFilter/CompositeFilter. advanced_filter.rs has separate (non-EventFilter-trait) filters ModuleFilter/RegexFilter/CallStackFilter/PerformanceFilter/AdvancedFilter. New Phase-3.3 filters (TimeRange/Value/Frequency/Path/User) should implement the EventFilter trait in filter.rs and be re-exported from lib.rs. Events: ExecutionEvent enum in events.rs has 5 EXHAUSTIVE `match self` methods that MUST get an arm for every new variant: id(), timestamp(), is_error(), location(), event_type(). Other matches on ExecutionEvent (explainer.rs main_text match, error_explainer.rs, formatter.rs text+html, filter.rs, advanced_filter.rs) use a `_` catch-all so they compile without changes but should get real handling for the new async variants where meaningful. lib.rs `pub use` re-exports every public type; add new types there. Formatters (HtmlFormatter/JsonFormatter/FormatterFactory) and ErrorExplainer already exist and should be reused by the CLI `report`/`analyze` subcommands rather than reimplemented. SourceLocation{file,line,column,offset}, Value enum, uuid::Uuid, chrono DateTime<Utc> are the building blocks for new events.

directory_structure: Repo root holds Cargo workspace + many (often inaccurate) *_COMPLETE.md status docs + PRODUCTION_READINESS_PLAN.md + repo-root Python demo/test scripts. xplainit-core/src/ = engine (events, filter, advanced_filter, explainer, error_explainer, formatter, event_store, pipeline, processor, sink, collector, runtime, control, ast, config). xplainit-cli/ = CLI crate (placeholder). xplainit-python/ = PyO3 bindings + Python test scripts. xplainit-node / xplainit-java / xplainit-c / xplainit-go = other bindings. .agents/tasks/ = prior Phase 1 & 2 task records. .github/workflows/ci.yml = CI.
